title: Courtesy Days on Home Purchase Agreement Closing Extensions When Construction Ran Late
content:
**Desk rule.** Calloway adds courtesy days to a buyer closing extension on a Home Purchase Agreement where its own construction ran late. The comparison is between the contract completion date stated at signing and the current estimated completion date on the agreement:

- where the estimated completion date fell **more than 21 calendar days** after the contract completion date, **14 courtesy days** are added;
- where it fell after the contract completion date by **21 calendar days or fewer**, **7 courtesy days** are added;
- otherwise no courtesy days are added.

Courtesy days are calendar days added to the days counted for the extension.

## Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical dates, contract completion date 1 September)

| Estimated completion date | Days after the contract completion date | Courtesy days |
|---|---|---|
| 1 September | 0 | None |
| 2 September | 1 | 7 |
| 22 September | 21 | 7 |
| 23 September | 22 | 14 |
| 25 August | Before the contract completion date | None |

**Points of judgement.**

- The slip is measured in calendar days from the contract completion date to the estimated completion date; the contract completion date stated at signing does not change.
- An estimated completion date on or before the contract completion date adds nothing.
